messages.content: Get me the timeline of World War 2 in Europe and then get me an array of important leaders involved during the war.

function.name: history_get_timeline
function.description: Retrieve the timeline for a specific historical event Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event.description: The historical event you want the timeline for.

function.name: history_get_important_figures
function.description: Retrieve array of important figures involved during a specific historical event. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event.description: The historical event for which you want the array of important figures.

number.description: Number of top figures you want. Default to 1
